Specification: This module is a thin Apalache-oriented wrapper around a separate helper module named RingBuffer. It introduces typed constants and a single variable ringbuffer, then instantiates RingBuffer so that the helper module can be typechecked in isolation. The comments explain that the underlying helper module defines Init and parameterized actions such as Write, EndWrite, BeginRead, and EndRead, but this wrapper itself does not define Next, temporal behavior, or fault handling, and leaves preservation of NoDataRaces to concrete protocol modules such as Disruptor_SPMC.
